## Status

This ticket's former standalone plan is superseded. Its valid production contract has been moved into fz-kdt.200, where it can land atomically with the authority it depends on.

## Preserved requirement

LoweredBody remains the sole operation/value/control denotation. Add only owner-qualified borrowed references or indexes consumed by the final direct InputDemand formula, and delete InputFlow without creating another semantic body.

No implementation from this ticket is to be restored or landed separately. Consult fz-kdt.200 for the current goal, signal, strategy, TDD, deletion list and ordering. This description replaces the former plan; comments or parked candidates are historical evidence only.
